newsitem.title: USA: Polar Air names Reichner as charter operations chief.
newsitem.headline: Polar Air names Reichner as charter operations chief.

text.p: California-based Polar Air Cargo said that Joseph J.Reichner has been appointed director of charter programmes.
He will be responsible for all aspects of Polar's charter services including sales, marketing, operations and the airline's Air Mobility Command contract, it added in a statement.
Reichner joined Polar after seven years at Tower Air where he was director of cargo sales and ground operations, it said.

Polar Air provides time-definite, airport-to-airport, scheduled all-cargo services with a fleet of 14 Boeing 747-100 freighters and one 747-200 freighter. A further 747-200F is on order, - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
